observe/attempt_1/response.json.content:
Answer: C) Multiple nodular masses with irregular margins and cavitation in the right lung, consistent with necrotising granulomatous vasculitis.  
Reason: Figure 1a (PA CXR) shows multiple ill-defined, irregularly margined opacities in the right lung with central lucency suggesting cavitation; Figure 1b (lateral view) confirms these are within the right hemithorax, not left or bilateral—supporting option C’s side-specific description and pathological features typical of GPA.
